title: No-nonsense Tunisian Rest-meat Quesadilla
description: A fusion of Tunisian flavors and ovo-vegetarian rest-meat, perfect for a quick weeknight fix.
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 tbsp olive oil and swirl it around to coat the pan.
Add the onion powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rest-meat and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Stir in the English mustard, canned tomatoes, Tunisian spice blend, and cumin. Cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the shredded cheese until it's melted and well combined with the rest-meat mixture.
Place a whole wheat tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle a quarter of the cheese-rest-meat mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the other side is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make 3 more quesadillas.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
